title: Therapeutic Targeting of Lyn Kinase To Treat Chorea-Acanthocytosis - an observational, non-interventional study
summary: Lyn kinase is an protein (tyrosine kinase) that has beend shown to be overactive in chorea-acanthocytosis (ChAc), an hereditary neurodegenerative disease. This study oberserves single ChAc patients that have been/are treated in the context of an off-label use of FDA/EMA-approved drugs that inhibit lyn kinase, e.g. Dasatinib and Nilotinib. The Participants receive/received interventions (Dasatinib/Nilotinib as individual off label treatment) as part of routine medical care.
conditions: Degenerative disease of basal ganglia, unspecified

interventions.name: Observation of clinical (clinical examination, UPDRS, UHDRS, clinical global, impression,  qualitiy of life, electrophyisiological data etc.) and paraclinical data (routine analysis for safety reasons, target engagement in the blood, e.g. lyn kinase activity analyisis) under off-label treatment to a

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients suffering from chorea-acanthocytosis (confirmed by chorein western blot and/or genetic testin), off-label therapy with Dasatinib or Nilotinib
Exclusion criteria:
not applicable
